The '''Ramoan'''<ref name="FJAP">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> was a [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Ramoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FJO" /><ref name="FJAP" /> The language sounded rough, and even a mild rebuke could sound threatening.<ref name="FJO" /> The anatomy of the Ramoan throat prevented them from speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="FJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bazel Warv]] could speak Basic when necessary, but his large [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] had difficulty shaping the common language's delicate vowels and subtle consonants.<ref name="FJAP" />
